claims.statement: Tom Allen and Joe Goss signed articles at Cincinnati on May 12, 1876 to fight under the new rules of the London prize ring for $5,000, with $2,500 staked by each man.

claims.statement: Tom Allen fought Joe Goss near Cincinnati on September 7, 1876, and the fight was decided for Goss on a foul; the paper said Allen was carried off unhurt while Goss was carried away beaten.

claims.statement: The Globe-Democrat correspondent said Allen had been shamefully robbed.

claims.statement: The paper said agreeing that the stakeholder would name the referee was the fatal move made by Allen and his friends.
